name: pep-verify
description: Drive and verify things directly in PEP (POLYPOINT's Delphi/VCL personnel-planning Windows client) on a tenant box over RDP/SSH/WinRM — element-level automation (pywinauto over a loopback agent), not pixel clicking. Runs a preflight check, bootstraps the companion pep-driver toolchain, then runs selector-based UI commands and flows.
